title: Res Nova: Geometrically Ordered Dynamics and Information Tension — μ_std Action, AeST Covariant Completion, and a Reproducible SPARC Benchmark
description: The interpolating function mu_dual(x) = x/(1+x) of the previous version was falsified on 2026-09-12: within two-derivative AeST/AQUAL it produces an unscreened anomalous acceleration ~5.7×10⁵ above the Cassini quadrupole bound. The theory is rebuilt on the live galaxy law mu_std(x) = x/√(1+x²) with F_std = ½[x√(1+x²) − arsinh x] under the AQUAL convention F′ = xμ (98 Lean 4 modules in the formal gate compile with 0 sorry and only the axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound; certifying mathematics, not physical ontology). The covariant completion is genuine AeST (Skordis–Złośnik, PRL 127, 161302): scalar field φ, entering through its kinetic invariant 𝒴, with minimal matter coupling on the V₂(ℝ³) Cartan-triality substrate; c_T = c is structural rather than asserted, and PPN γ = 1 is derived free-function-independently. The Q⁴ + covariant running λ_s(Q) cosmological closure passes the 626-bin Planck 2018 plik_lite + DESI DR2 BAO fit at 1.35σ (Δχ² = +1.82, H₀ = 70.04 km/s/Mpc); Cosh equality tracking and unscreened hydrostatic AeST dust at X-COP R₂₀₀ are killed [X]. SPARC 175-galaxy benchmark under μ_std: a₀ = 1.161×10⁻¹⁰ m/s² (bootstrap 95% 0.972–1.295; the earlier 1.116 was a 171-galaxy fit under the retired μ_dual); high-z a₀(z) tests remain inconclusive. Scope ruling (2026-11-21, 02_galaxy_dynamics/GALAXY_LAW_SCOPE_2026-11-21.md; OUTSIDE_GALAXIES.md; Erratum E-16): μ_std with measured a₀ is the galaxy law scored on galaxies, while ordinary general relativity holds outside galaxies; the agent-written joint Cassini × SPARC gate is withdrawn and computed Saturn extrapolation numbers remain archived strictly as out-of-domain extrapolation measurements. The normalisation a₀ = cH₀/2π is declared, not derived: horizon-temperature (KMS) matching gives a = cH, with the 2π cancelling.
